name: Both Buttons Pressed
look: A two-panel comic. Top: a white-gloved hand presses two red buttons at once, one with the thumb and one with a finger, under two blank white labels on a blue control panel. Bottom: a man in a red shirt grins smugly and gives a thumbs-up.
use: A follow-up to the two-buttons dilemma. Instead of agonizing over the choice, the person picks both options at once and is very pleased with the result.
examples: Me with a fruit salad covered in chocolate
describe: hand pressing both red buttons at the same time
guy pushing two buttons at once and giving a thumbs up
sweaty button guy finally picks both options and is happy
comic of a man smugly choosing both choices
two red buttons pressed together then a satisfied thumbs up
origin: An edit of Jake Clark's Two Buttons comic in which both buttons get pressed, signed @Petirep next to Jake Clark's credit.
